correctness.rationale: Every nonzero proper ideal is indexed by a nonempty proper support, and adjacency is disjointness. Each co-singleton has a unique singleton neighbor, forcing all coordinate minimal ideals into every total dominating set. They form a dominating clique. Paired minima follow from parity and explicit perfect matchings.
